_comments: Approval of an exception to payment-gated access (bizapps-orders#268). Its own type, rather
than the generic Approval Request, so that closing the task in the Tasks inbox runs the Action that
applies the decision to the override. IsApproval lists its tasks in the Tasks approvals inbox; its OnAssign
action posts each assignment to the Teams channel named by the 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential called
ORDERS_ACCESS_OVERRIDE (bizapps-orders#360). Without that credential the tasks app falls back to the default
'Teams Channel Webhook' credential, so create it before this metadata is pushed.

fields.Name: Access Override Approval
fields.Description: Approve or reject an exception to payment-gated access on an order. Closing the task applies the decision to the override.

_comments: Approval of a Pending concession (golive #274, #312). Its own type, rather than the generic Approval
Request, so that its OnAssign action posts concession approvals, and only those, to the Teams channel
named by the 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential called ORDERS_CONCESSION_APPROVAL. Without that credential the
tasks app falls back to the default 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential, so create it before this metadata is
pushed. IsApproval lists its tasks in the Tasks approvals inbox.

fields.Name: Concession Approval
fields.Description: Approve or reject a Pending concession on an order. The order cannot be confirmed, and its documents cannot be sent, until the concession is decided.

_comments: Review of an order that hit a review trigger before it may confirm (bc-aidp-next-golive#320 section 5). Its own
type, rather than the generic Approval Request or sales' ORDER_REVIEW (raised for every won deal), so the
confirm gate can find an order's reviews by Code and so a host can route its OnAssign notices separately.
IsApproval lists its tasks in the Tasks approvals inbox. An approving decision by an assignee lets the order
confirm; nothing runs on completion, the confirm reads the decision.

fields.Name: Order Review
fields.Description: Review an order that hit a review trigger. Approve to let it confirm, or reject with a note saying what to correct. A change to the order after approval sends it back for review.
